definitions.explanation: An area of grass, trees, or other vegetation, especially one set aside for recreational use or environmental preservation in an urban setting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緑地|りょくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{緑地|りょくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new green area was developed in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{緑地|りょくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧{遊|あそ}ばせられる。
examples.english: There's green space spread around the apartment building, so I can let my children play there without worry.

notes:
A compound of {緑|りょく} (green) and {地|ち} (ground; land). Used in urban planning and environmental contexts to describe areas of vegetation preserved or created within developed areas. Japan's ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧{計画法|けいかくほう} (City Planning Act) defines {緑地|りょくち} as a formal land-use category.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緑地|りょくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧: to develop green space
- {緑地|りょくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保全|ほぜん}→保全：11560_hozen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to conserve green space
- {緑地|りょくち}⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧: green park; parkland
- {緑地|りょくち}{帯|たい}: green belt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧: park — a developed recreational area with facilities; {緑地|りょくち} may be less developed
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧: greenery — the plants and vegetation themselves, not the land
- ⟦{森林|しんりん}→森林：01441_shinrin⟧: forest — larger natural wooded areas, not typically urban
